purpose: One owner-authorized B3 versus B8 retrieval-only comparison
changed_variable: Number of original semantic seed hits scanned, and nothing else

controls.budget_scope: Complete unmodified grounded prompt; serialized context tokens reported separately; chat-template overhead excluded as before
controls.ranking: Exact production float32 cosine, NO/general filter, descending score and ascending ID tie-break; original saved query vectors and unchanged index
controls.packing: Same narrow branch expansion, corpus order, deduplication and atomic whole-packet admission; skip an over-budget packet and continue through remaining original seeds; no eviction, truncation or below-top-k refill
controls.tokenizer: Existing llama-tokenize and locked Qwen GGUF; tokenization only
controls.token_cache: Reuse prior token IDs only when exact input/hash, tokenizer binary and GGUF hashes match

scoring.must_have: Same strict binary information-based rules and existing semantic judgements. Partial facts or missing conditions count zero. Optional facts/source count do not improve score.
scoring.B3: Reproduce old B exactly, including context/counts, and preserve old manual scoring unchanged
scoring.B8: Inspect delivered context and manually annotate new evidence/noise; existing facts and rules unchanged
scoring.supported_metrics: Micro coverage, average per-case coverage, complete passes, irrelevant/misleading context separately, geography leakage, chunk/section counts and exact tokens
scoring.gaps: Cases 14/15 reported separately, never added to supported coverage/pass denominators; no abstention score
scoring.burn_cream: Cream/ointment conflict in case 07 excluded from success/noise decisions
scoring.budget_diagnosis: Record every rejected packet, its candidate token count, would-add passage IDs and relevant missing information if any; no unbudgeted third configuration

stop: Return results for owner review; do not optimize, change production or begin generation evaluation
